newsitem.title: USA: Tech Data sees FY98 revenues near $6 bln.
newsitem.headline: Tech Data sees FY98 revenues near $6 bln.

text.p: Tech Data Corp expects revenues in fiscal 1998 ending January 30 to approach $6 billion and is comfortable with Wall Street earnings estimates for the fiscal year in the area of $1.60 per share, said Chief Executive Steven Raymund.

On Tuesday, at a Raymond James investors conference here, Raymund said the company is comfortable with analysts' estimates of fourth-quarter earnings of $0.38 to $0.40 per share, up from $0.24 per share in the year-ago period.
"The estimate we have given is $0.38 to $0.40. We're still comfortable with that," said Chief Financial Officer Jeff Howells.
The Clearwater, Fla.-based wholesaler of computer products is expected to report fiscal 1997 results later this month.

Operating on paper-thin margins, Tech Data holds about 11 percent of the $37 billion U.S. computer wholesaling and distributing market and sells more than 45,000 products from 600 manufacturers and publishers. Almost two-thirds of the company's sales are made to resellers, Raymund said.
